auto_sync_new_schemas.description: Automatically enable syncing for schemas discovered on this source after creation, on both the scheduled discovery pass and manual schema refreshes. Defaults to false. Not supported for direct-query sources.

auto_sync_schema_patterns.description: Optional fnmatch-style globs (`*` and `?` wildcards) restricting which newly discovered schema names auto-sync, matched case-insensitively against both the qualified and bare table name. Null or empty means every new schema qualifies. Only used when `auto_sync_new_schemas` is true.

created_via.description:
How this source was created. Defaults to `api` on create when omitted. `web` for the in-app UI, `api` for direct API callers, `mcp` for agent/MCP tool calls, `wizard` for the setup wizard and `self_driving` for the PostHog Desktop app (both derived server-side from the caller's user agent). Ignored on update.

* `web` - web
* `api` - api
* `mcp` - mcp
* `wizard` - wizard
* `self_driving` - self_driving

direct_query_enabled.description: Whether this synced source is also live-queryable via direct connection. Defaults to false for new sources; ignored for pure direct-query sources.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this external data source.

payload.description: Update only. Reconnects the source or rotates its credentials with a stored credential, so secrets do not go through the request. Send {'credential_id': '<uuid>'}.

credential_id.description: Id of a stored credential to reconnect this source with. The user enters new connection details on the page that data-warehouse-source-connect-link returns, and the id comes from the stored_credentials list. Only the user who stored the credential can use it, and it must be for this source's source_type and not expired. Its values replace the source's connection details, then the connection is checked. The stored credential is deleted when the update succeeds.
